policy: References informed taxonomy, adult size, body proportions, fin placement and the diagnostic axine only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed.

sources.title: Trigonostigma heteromorpha species summary
evidenceCues: Maximum adult total length is 5.0 cm.
Cross section is compressed; the head-to-predorsal profile is steep and the mouth is terminal.
The axine has dorsal, ventral and caudal apices near the dorsal-fin origin, pelvic-fin origin and caudal-fin base.

sources.title: Trigonostigma truncata, a new species of harlequin rasbora from Malay Peninsula (Teleostei: Danionidae)
sources.author: Tan Heok Hui
sources.license: Copyright National University of Singapore; no image reuse performed
evidenceCues: The T. heteromorpha axine is large and velvety black, with a straight anterior margin and dorsal, ventral and caudal apices.
The caudal apex extends along the peduncle to the caudal-fin base; the broad anterior span exceeds two-thirds of body depth.
The species has a steep convex predorsal profile, terminal mouth, orange-red dorsal base and forked caudal.

sources.title: Harlequin Rasbora.jpg
sources.author: Mariusz Dabrowski
sources.provenance: Author's own work, 21 July 2011; original 5184 by 3456 file page, not the later crop.
evidenceCues: Deep compressed trunk, steep dorsal head-to-back rise, large eye and small terminal mouth.
Dorsal, pelvic and anal placement plus a fully visible forked caudal silhouette.
Axine is a bounded flank triangle that narrows toward the peduncle instead of filling the posterior body.

sources.title: Rasbora h.jpg
sources.author: -serwacy01-
sources.view: high-detail lateral head and anterior fins
sources.provenance: Author's own work, photographed 23 December 2022; original 5184 by 3456 file page.
evidenceCues: Bluntly pointed snout, terminal mouth at the midline, large round eye and short opercular region.
Steep predorsal slope, deep chest, orange-red dorsal and translucent paired and anal fins.
Posterior tail is cropped, so this image does not control caudal proportions.

sources.title: Trigonostigma heteromorpha in Malaysia, photo 251680901
sources.author: Zakqary Roy
sources.provenance: Original iNaturalist photo from Malaysia, 12 January 2023; license reviewed by INaturalistReviewBot on Wikimedia Commons.
evidenceCues: Wild-specimen proportions and full forked caudal silhouettes guard against exaggerated aquarium-bred depth.
Axine reaches the caudal-fin base and dorsal-fin position aligns with the broad anterior end of the wedge.

sources.title: Trigonostigma heteromorpha breeding2.jpg
sources.author: Stefan Maurer
sources.view: inverted head-on and ventral-oblique spawning view
sources.provenance: Originally posted to Flickr as DSC02740; Commons verified the license on upload.
evidenceCues: Qualitatively supports a narrow side-to-side section relative to vertical body depth.
Motion blur, foreshortening and spawning posture prohibit calibrated head width or top-outline inference.

sources.title: Trigonostigma heteromorpha, MNHN1912-0141
sources.publisher: SIGNIFY, Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum
sources.author: SIGNIFY, Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum
sources.provenance: Nontype specimen from Singapore, catalog MNHN1912-0141; copyright Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle.
evidenceCues: Corroborates deep trunk, short peduncle, steep head-to-back transition and bilateral fin placement.
Preservation and collapsed fins prohibit using it for live fin outline or coloration.

viewCoverage.lateral: Strong: multiple original live-fish pages plus a museum voucher and peer-reviewed figure.
viewCoverage.headAndFins: Strong laterally: high-detail original imagery and FishBase morphology agree on the terminal mouth, steep predorsal profile and fin positions.
viewCoverage.topAndBodyDepth: Limited: FishBase explicitly classifies the cross section as compressed, and one oblique spawning image corroborates it qualitatively.
viewCoverage.front: Limited: no verified sharp orthographic frontal original was found.

referenceGradeRationale: Authoritative morphology and several exact, licensed lateral originals strongly constrain the outline, fins and three-apex axine. No verified true dorsal/top or sharp frontal original was found, so exact width and frontal head shape remain intentionally uncertain.
